name: alex
description: Alex's Claude Code plugins. alex-ring asks before loading alex-superpowers and alex-ponytail, and alex-i-have-adhd turns on when you say "adhd mode".

plugins.name: alex-ring
plugins.description: One ring: asks once per session before loading alex-superpowers and alex-ponytail for code work. Installs all three other plugins.

plugins.name: alex-superpowers
plugins.description: Planning, TDD, debugging and review workflows (fork of obra/superpowers).

plugins.name: alex-ponytail
plugins.description: The smallest change that fully solves the task (fork of DietrichGebert/ponytail).

plugins.name: alex-i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Action-first replies for ADHD readers (fork of ayghri/i-have-adhd).
